---
title: "Stats — Court reliability ranking"
description: "Per-tribunal collection rate (uploaded vs absent)."
output: /data/court_reliability.json
format: array
---

Confiabilidade por tribunal: razão de dias `uploaded` sobre o total de dias
em que sabemos o status (uploaded + absent). Usado para os rankings Top 5
mais/menos confiáveis na página de indicadores.

```{sql}
WITH known AS (
  SELECT
    tribunal,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS collected,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = 'absent') AS absent
  FROM manifest
  GROUP BY tribunal
)
SELECT
  tribunal AS court,
  collected,
  absent,
  collected + absent AS total,
  CASE WHEN collected + absent > 0
    THEN ROUND(1.0 * collected / (collected + absent), 4)::DOUBLE
    ELSE 0
  END AS rate
FROM known
WHERE collected + absent > 0
ORDER BY rate DESC, total DESC;
```
